strings.코랄시티 문제를 해결하러 와주셨군요!: You've come to deal with the problem in Coral City!
I heard something serious had happened.
strings.이제 그 문제가 뭔지 알아보러 왔는데, 코랄시티라고 하셨나요? 처음 듣는: I've come to find out what it is. Did you say Coral City? I've never heard of it...
Since you mentioned it the moment you saw me, I assume that's where the trouble is.
Exactly. Coral City is an underwater city that was destroyed in ancient times.
But recently, the entire city suddenly came back to life.
strings.도시 전체에 펼쳐진 강력한 결계가 모든 걸 차단하고 있어서 현재 진입할: A powerful barrier surrounds the whole city and blocks everything, so we can't enter at the moment.
For better or worse, we've also heard that the barrier is weakening... It's complicated.
strings.그러니까 갑자기 부활한 해저 문명이 문제라는 거죠?: So the problem is an underwater civilization that suddenly returned?
strings.네. 그 문명의 구성원들이 정상이 아닌 것 같다는 소리가 들려오고 있어서: Yes. I'm worried because reports suggest that its inhabitants aren't in their right minds.
You should hear from an expert who knows more than I do.
strings.그곳에 역사학자 엘레나 님이 있을 겁니다. 유일하게 그 안으로 들어간 사: The historian Elena should be there. She's the only person who has managed to get inside.
strings.엥? 역사학자가 그곳에 있다니 무슨 일이죠?: Huh? What's a historian doing there?
strings.고대 코랄시티 주민들의 몇 안 남은 후손이라 들어갈 수 있었던 걸지도 모: She may have been able to enter because she's one of the few remaining descendants of ancient Coral City's people.
strings.자신의 뿌리를 자세히 알고 싶다고 코랄시티를 전문적으로 연구하는 역사학자: She wanted to learn more about her roots, so she became a historian specializing in Coral City.
Ask Elena about the city. What she knows should help.
Thank you. I'll go right away.
strings.누구죠? 여긴 대체 어떻게 들어온 거죠? 아무나 들어올 수 없는 곳인데…: Who are you? How did you get in here? Not just anyone can enter this place... Wait, are you...
The one Usher, Mari, and so many others have been talking about...
strings.그러니까 이리스라는 영웅을 찾아 세계를 돌아다니고 있다는 그 모험가…,: The adventurer traveling the world in search of a hero named Iris... right?
strings.네. 맞아요. 그리고 지금은 코랄시티 문제를 해결하러 엘레나 씨에게 이야: Yes, that's me. And now I'm here to hear what you know, Elena, so I can deal with Coral City's problems.
strings.오래전 멸망했다던 문명이 갑자기 등장한 이유가 뭔가요?: Why has a civilization that was destroyed long ago suddenly reappeared?
I have a feeling it might be connected to another problem I know about.
Though I can't tell you the details...
strings.그 이리스라는 영웅과 관련된 일인가요?: Does it have something to do with that hero, Iris?
Judging by your expression, I think it does.
You seem to have come to learn about Coral City, so I should tell you what I know.
strings.고대 시절에 아름다운 해저 도시였던 코랄시티는 해저 화산 때문에 멸망한: Records say that Coral City, once a beautiful underwater city, was destroyed by an undersea volcano.
strings.해저 화산…. 그, 그러면 여기도 위험한 거 아닌가요?: An undersea volcano... D-doesn't that mean we're in danger here too?
Even if it doesn't happen right away, it could erupt again...
strings.알아보니 당분간은 해저 화산이 폭발할 일은 없다고 하네요. 아니, 지금: From what I've learned, the undersea volcano isn't expected to erupt anytime soon. No, that's not the issue right now...
Usher and Mari trust you, so I will too.
Of course. I know them both very well.
strings.그래서 뭘 하실 건가요?: So what are you going to do?
I'm not sure yet. That's what I need to find out.
That's impossible. You went in and came back so easily...
strings.저야 후손이라 별 위험이 없긴 하지만, 외지인인 모험가님이면 분명 힘들었: As a descendant, I'm not in much danger, but it should have been difficult for an outsider like you...
Actually, why did someone this extraordinary only arrive now...?
There's something you want, isn't there? All this praise...
strings.연구를 돕고, 유적이나 유물 관련 정보가 있으면 건네주고…, 뭐 그런 거: You want help with your research, and any information I find about ruins or artifacts... something like that?
It's embarrassing to have you see right through me.
Hehehe. We can discuss the details later. I need to go somewhere first.
I still don't have a clear idea of what I should do.
Please wait here. I'll be back soon.
strings.정말 다시 돌아오시는 건가요?: You really will come back, won't you?
strings.그냥 이대로 가버리시면 저주할지도 몰라요!!: If you just leave me here, I might curse you!!
strings.이스트 랜드의 루맨과 마법 통신이요?: Magical communication with Lumen in the East Land?
That will be easy enough if you can give me the communication code.
Here. I was given this, so I'll pass it to you.
Ah, yes, this is it. One moment. I'll connect you.
Hmm, let's see... Ah, there we go.
Yes. Thanks to you, I arrived safely. Now, about what's happened here...
As I mentioned before, similar things are happening all over the world.
Lady Iris's incomplete awakening has disrupted part of the balance.
strings.세상에는 균형을 맞추는 일종의 법칙이 있다고 해요. 신의 존재도 그중에: They say the world has certain laws that maintain its balance. The existence of gods is one of them...
strings.세레스 여신을 대신할 이리스 님이 저렇게 불안정하기 때문에 일종의 흐름이: Since Lady Iris, who is to replace the goddess Seres, is so unstable, the natural course of things has become distorted.
Something reappearing across space and time should be utterly impossible.
strings.이리스님이 제대로 각성을 할 때까지 계속 이렇게 균형이 깨진 부작용이 발: Until Lady Iris awakens properly, these side effects of the broken balance will keep happening.
strings.후우…, 설명만 들어도 답답하네요. 제가 어떻게 하면 될까요?: Sigh... Even hearing the explanation is frustrating. What can I do?
I feel sorry for the people of Coral City, who have returned as restless spirits, but...
strings.모험가님께서 항상 하던 대로 결계가 유지되고 있을 때, 그들을 모두 쓰러: You must defeat them all while the barrier is still holding, just as you have always done.
It's unfortunate, but that's the best thing you can do right now.
strings.결정하신 건가요? 저 도와주시는 거 맞죠?: Have you decided? You're going to help me, right?
strings.아, 아니…. 제가 도와드려도 괜찮은 건가요?: Oh, no... I mean, would it be all right if I helped you?
I think we need to stop Coral City's inhabitants from getting outside the barrier.
strings.죽기 바로 직전 상태로 부활한 거라서 혼란과 폭주 상태가 계속 유지될 거: They were brought back in the state they were in just before death, so I've been told they'll remain confused and out of control.
We have no choice but to defeat them all.
strings.(엘레나는 큰 충격을 받은 듯, 한참을 멍하니 있었다.): (Elena stares blankly for a long time, seemingly in deep shock.)
strings.괜찮아요? 괜찮아요? 정신 차려요!: Are you all right? Are you all right? Come back to your senses!
N-no, I'm fine! I'm really fine...
strings.모두를 위해서 그러는 게 나을지도 모르겠어요. 그런데, 저 많은 사람을: Perhaps that would be best for everyone. But can you really take on so many people?
I can. It's what I've been doing all along.
Since there are so many of them, I think it would be best to strike quickly and pull back.
strings.아무리 그래도 나라 전체를 상대하는 건데…, 너무 쉽게 생각하는 거 아닌: Even so, you're taking on an entire country... Aren't you treating this a little too lightly?
strings.괜찮아요. 그러면 절 도와주세요. 그런데 어떻게 도와주실 건가요?: It'll be fine. Please help me, then. How can you help?
I can tell you about the routes through the city.
I can give you information about its inhabitants too.
Like the sacred beast Leviathan, or King Ocellino, who was revered as a sea god at the time.
Listen carefully. Once you enter Coral City, the first thing you need to do is...
First, you must head to Song of the Coral.
To get there, you'll need to defeat those blocking the way.
You seem to know everything about this area.
This is what I've always done.
strings.오오, 그러면 저는 누구를 상대하면 되나요?: Oh, then who should I take on?
It's an area where traces of coral dragons wearing sawshark gloves were often found.
There are probably plenty of coral dragons there now.
strings.그곳을 지나치면 바로 산호의 노래로 진입하실 수 있지만 조심하세요. 아셨: Once you pass that area, you can enter Song of the Coral directly. But be careful, all right?
Now go inside Song of the Coral and face the Leviathans.
There will be many spirits of the city's people inside too, so you must be extremely careful.
strings.산호의 노래는 어떤 곳이죠?: What kind of place is Song of the Coral?
It's a very beautiful, mysterious place.
strings.형형색색 빛나는 산호들이 서로 부딪쳐 아름다운 화음을 만들고,: Corals glowing in every color brush against one another and create beautiful harmonies.
In ancient times, they say Leviathan would fall asleep to those harmonies as a lullaby.
You can still hear the coral singing, but don't listen too closely.
The sound carries the energy of death now, so it could be dangerous.
Twinkive was a place the king and the citizens often visited.
Somewhere the king and ordinary citizens went together? That couldn't have been easy to arrange.
Ocellino, Coral City's last king, was deeply attached to the place.
He believed that all living beings could become friends.
He even invited fishermen to visit Coral City.
strings.신의 축복을 받아 바다의 권능을 가지게 됐고, 바다의 신으로도 추앙받았죠: Blessed by a god, he gained authority over the sea and was revered as a sea god himself.
Twinkive is where you'll find King Ocellino.
I think that's all I can tell you.
I'll go and see the rest for myself. I'll be back soon, so don't worry too much.
strings.또 오셨군요. 아까 그 코드로 연결하면 되죠?: You're back. I should use the same code as before, right?
strings.네. 신수와 왕이라는 존재를 처치했는데…, 아직도 병력이 좀 남아 있어요: Yes. I defeated the sacred beast and the one they called the king... but some troops are still left.
I thought taking out the leaders first would do it.
Then eliminate all the remaining troops as well. After that, get some rest.
We don't know what might happen in other regions.
If anything serious comes up, I'll let you know immediately.
strings.뭐, 일종의 그런 거겠죠?: Well, something like that, I suppose.
I have an urgent meeting now, so I'll have to end the call here.
All right. You're working hard too, Yuran.
You're having a much harder time than I am.
All because you ended up with the wrong god...
strings.저, 저기…. 일은 다 끝나신 건가요?: Um, excuse me... Is your work finished?
There are still some remaining troops to deal with, but I'd say it's almost done.
strings.그러면 모험가 님이 약속을 지킬 차례네요!: Then it's time for you to keep your promise!
strings.맞죠? 약속 지키실 거죠?: Right? You will keep it, won't you?
What should I do? I'm rather busy...
strings.(엘레나가 울상을 짓는다. ): (Elena looks as though she's about to cry.)
strings.아, 알았어요. 뭘 하면 될까요?: A-all right. What do you need?
strings.약속 지켜주실 줄 알았어요!: I knew you'd keep your promise!
strings.앞으로도 제가 연구할 수 있게 코랄시티의 유물들 가져오시면 될 것 같아요: Just bring me artifacts from Coral City so I can continue my research.
If that's all, I can do it anytime.
Thank you. I'll be counting on you from now on.
